name: DataForSEO
one_liner: DataForSEO is a REST API platform providing SEO, SERP, keyword, backlink, and business-data scraping/analytics data for developers.
needs_human_reasons: only 43% of quotes grounded in cited pages

evidence.quote: DataForSEO is using the Basic Authentication, which makes it possible to call our APIs with almost any programming language.
Create a free account with DataForSEO
the API password is generated automatically by DataForSEO and is different from your account password
With DataForSEO you pay only for the individual services you consume.
Review the kickstart guide to APIs
Empower AI integration with DataForSEO MCP

notes: Free account signup yields Basic Auth login/password (API password auto-generated, distinct from account password) via API Access dashboard; pay-as-you-go for live data ($50 min payment) but sandbox/free unlimited trial mode is documented separately for testing. Official MCP server published by vendor (GitHub Apr 2025, npm May 2025) at https://mcp.dataforseo.com/v3/mcp, using same Basic Auth credentials. Composio wraps it (not the official MCP) with 312 tools/endpoints across SERP, Keywords, Backlinks, OnPage, Business Data, Domain Analytics, Content Analysis products, indicating large breadth.
